title: Enclosure with screw bosses and a lid

description.en: A small electronics enclosure in two bodies. The box: outside 80 x 60 x 30 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z), a 2 mm wall on the bottom and the four sides, open at the top. Inside, four screw bosses of 7 mm diameter stand on the floor and reach the rim (Z = 30); their axes are 9 mm in from both outside edges at each corner, and each has a 2.5 mm pilot hole 10 mm deep from its top. The lid: a plate 80 x 60 x 2 mm lying on the box (Z from 30 to 32), with a locating lip under it that fits inside the box's walls with 0.2 mm clearance all round: a rectangular ring 1.5 mm thick and 3 mm deep. The lid has four 3.2 mm holes over the bosses. Drive it by the variables length, width, height, wall, boss_d, boss_hole, boss_depth, inset, lid_t, lip_h, lip_t, gap and lid_hole.
description.nl: Een kleine behuizing voor elektronica, in twee lichamen. De bak: buitenmaat 80 x 60 x 30 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z), een wand van 2 mm op de bodem en de vier zijden, bovenaan open. Binnenin staan vier schroefpennen (bosses) van 7 mm diameter op de bodem tot aan de rand (Z = 30); hun as ligt 9 mm van beide buitenranden in elke hoek, en elk heeft een voorboorgat van 2,5 mm, 10 mm diep vanaf de bovenkant. Het deksel: een plaat van 80 x 60 x 2 mm die op de bak ligt (Z van 30 tot 32), met eronder een centreerrand die binnen de wanden van de bak past met 0,2 mm speling rondom: een rechthoekige ring van 1,5 mm dik en 3 mm diep. Het deksel heeft vier gaten van 3,2 mm boven de pennen. Stuur het met de variabelen length, width, height, wall, boss_d, boss_hole, boss_depth, inset, lid_t, lip_h, lip_t, gap en lid_hole.

variables.name: inset
variables.meaning: boss axis to each nearby outside edge

variables.name: gap
variables.meaning: clearance between lip and box wall

variables.name: lid_hole

derivation: Box: the block less the hollow (L - 2w)(W - 2w)(H - w), plus four bosses pi/4 bd^2 (H - w) standing on the floor, less four pilot holes pi/4 bh^2 depth.
Lid: the plate L W tl, the lip ring (Lo Wo - Ln Wn) hl with Lo = L - 2w - 2g and Ln = Lo - 2 lt, less four holes pi/4 dl^2 tl. Box 28946.0 mm^3, lid 10689.5 mm^3, together 39635.4 mm^3.

Area of the box: the outside without the top opening, the hollow's floor and four walls; each boss adds its wall pi bd (H - w) (its top replaces the floor it stands on) and its pilot hole adds its wall pi bh depth (its bottom replaces the top it takes). Lid: the plate, the lip's four walls outside and inside (its underside replaces the plate's underside it covers), and each hole swaps two discs for its wall.
Centroid Z from the moments: the hollow's centre at (H + w)/2, the bosses' at (H + w)/2, the pilots' at H - depth/2, the plate's at H + tl/2, the lip's at H - hl/2. X and Y by symmetry.
Two bodies, each one shell: the lid is a separate body that touches the box's rim, not fused to it.
